title: Pay into the Mining Rehabilitation Fund when required
what: If the Minister requires it, pay into the Mining Rehabilitation Fund the amount the Minister decides, before the tenement ends or within the prescribed period after.

sources.title: Mining Act 1971 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The Minister may, after taking into account the matters specified in subsection (4), require a tenement holder (or former tenement holder) to pay an amount determined by the Minister into the fund
